title: Coconut Italian Panna Cotta with Caramelized Figs
description: A creamy Italian dessert featuring caramelized figs, coconut, and a floral twist.
instructions: 1. In a medium saucepan, combine the caramelized figs and sweetened condensed milk. Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is heated through.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut cream, vanilla extract, and floral honey until smooth.
3. Add the heavy cream to the coconut mixture and whisk until well combined.
4. Pour the coconut mixture into individual serving cups or ramekins.
5. Spoon the caramelized fig mixture over the top of the coconut mixture.
6. Sprinkle the coconut flakes over the top of the fig mixture.
7. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
8. Serve chilled, garnished with additional coconut flakes and caramelized figs if desired.
